summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Bragg Gaming Group announcing only the release date of its first quarter 2026 financial results on May 14, 2026, with a subsequent conference call. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine earnings announcement schedule and does not affect shareholder rights or corporate structure. As a foreign private issuer Form 6-K, it is equivalent to a domestic earnings press release. No special-situation category applies.
